manual.preamble: Rules the person at this desk confirmed from their own work. Follow them for the choices they cover. If a choice comes up that no rule here covers, or information you need is missing, do not guess: ask the owner with ask_owner.

price.hold: R1. When a customer asks for a lower price: Keep the list price. Explain kindly that this is already our best price, and do not give a discount.
price.small: R1. When a customer asks for a lower price: Give the smallest discount you can, about 1% off the list price, even when your authority allows more.
price.full: R1. When a customer asks for a lower price: Give the full discount your authority allows, right away.

date.ask: R2. When a request does not say when it must ship: Ask the customer for the ship date before preparing a quote.
date.earliest: R2. When a request does not say when it must ship: Do not ask. Prepare the quote with the earliest ship date the stock allows, and tell the customer that date.
